components.title: AWS CloudTrail & CloudWatch
components.description: AWS CloudTrail & CloudWatch as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

control-implementations.description: Controls satisfied by AWS CloudTrail & CloudWatch.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.7: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions; capture in audit logs (AWS: IAM / CloudTrail)
AU.L2-3.3.1: Create and retain system audit logs sufficient for monitoring and investigation (AWS: CloudTrail / CloudWatch Logs / S3)
AU.L2-3.3.2: Ensure actions can be traced to individual users for accountability (AWS: CloudTrail (identity) / IAM)
AU.L2-3.3.4: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure (AWS: CloudWatch Alarms / SNS)
AU.L2-3.3.7: Provide a system capability that compares to an authoritative time source (AWS: Amazon Time Sync / NTP)
AU.L2-3.3.8: Protect audit information and tools from unauthorized access/modification (AWS: S3 Object Lock / KMS / IAM)

components.title: AWS Config
components.description: AWS Config as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

implemented-requirements.description: CM.L2-3.4.1: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories (AWS: Config / Systems Manager Inventory)
CM.L2-3.4.2: Establish and enforce security configuration settings (AWS: Config Rules / SSM State Manager)
CA.L2-3.12.3: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis (AWS: Config / Security Hub)

components.title: AWS GuardDuty / Security Hub / Budgets
components.description: AWS GuardDuty / Security Hub / Budgets as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

control-implementations.description: Controls satisfied by AWS GuardDuty / Security Hub / Budgets.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.12: Monitor and control remote access sessions (AWS: VPN / Systems Manager Session Manager)
AC.L2-3.1.13: Use cryptographic mechanisms to protect remote access sessions (AWS: TLS / SSM Session Manager)
AU.L2-3.3.5: Correlate audit review/analysis for investigation and response (AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / Security Hub)
MA.L2-3.7.5: Require MFA to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions (AWS: SSM Session Manager / MFA)
RA.L2-3.11.2: Scan for vulnerabilities periodically and when new ones are identified (AWS: Amazon Inspector / ECR scanning)
SI.L2-3.14.1: Identify report and correct system flaws in a timely manner (AWS: SSM Patch / Inspector)
SI.L2-3.14.2: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations (AWS: Endpoint AV / GuardDuty)
SI.L2-3.14.3: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action (AWS: Security Hub / SNS / Health)
SI.L2-3.14.4: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available (AWS: Managed AV / GuardDuty (managed))
SI.L2-3.14.5: Perform periodic and real-time scans of the system (AWS: Inspector / GuardDuty)
SI.L2-3.14.6: Monitor systems including inbound/outbound traffic to detect attacks (AWS: GuardDuty / VPC Flow Logs)
SI.L2-3.14.7: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems (AWS: GuardDuty / CloudTrail / Config)

components.title: AWS IAM
components.description: AWS IAM as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.1: Limit system access to authorized users and devices (AWS: IAM / SSO / Organizations)
AC.L2-3.1.2: Limit access to the types of transactions and functions authorized users may execute (AWS: IAM policies / SCPs)
AC.L2-3.1.4: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce risk of malevolent activity (AWS: IAM roles / permission boundaries)
AC.L2-3.1.5: Employ least privilege including for privileged accounts (AWS: IAM Access Analyzer / permission boundaries)
AC.L2-3.1.11: Terminate user sessions after a defined condition (AWS: IAM session duration / STS)
AU.L2-3.3.9: Limit management of audit logging to a subset of privileged users (AWS: IAM policies)
CM.L2-3.4.8: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklist) or permit-by-exception (whitelist) policy (AWS: SCPs / Security Groups)
IA.L2-3.5.1: Identify system users processes and devices (AWS: IAM / IAM Roles / Cognito)
IA.L2-3.5.2: Authenticate identities as a prerequisite to system access (AWS: IAM / IdP / Cognito)
IA.L2-3.5.3: Use multifactor authentication for privileged and network access (AWS: IAM MFA / IdP MFA)
IA.L2-3.5.4: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms (AWS: IAM / TLS / TOTP)
IA.L2-3.5.7: Enforce a minimum password complexity (AWS: IAM password policy)
IA.L2-3.5.8: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations (AWS: IAM password policy)
IA.L2-3.5.9: Allow temporary password use with immediate change to permanent (AWS: IAM password policy)
IA.L2-3.5.10: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords (AWS: IAM / KMS / TLS)

components.title: AWS KMS & S3
components.description: AWS KMS & S3 as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

control-implementations.description: Controls satisfied by AWS KMS & S3.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.3: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations (AWS: VPC / Security Groups / S3 policies)
AC.L2-3.1.22: Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems (AWS: S3 Block Public Access / Config)
MP.L2-3.8.1: Protect system media containing CUI (paper and digital) (AWS: KMS / S3 encryption)
MP.L2-3.8.2: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users (AWS: IAM / S3 policies)
MP.L2-3.8.6: Implement cryptographic protection of CUI on digital media during transport (AWS: KMS / TLS)
MP.L2-3.8.9: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations (AWS: AWS Backup / S3 / KMS)
SC.L2-3.13.4: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared resources (AWS: IAM / KMS / tenant isolation)
SC.L2-3.13.8: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect CUI in transit (AWS: TLS / ACM)
SC.L2-3.13.10: Establish and manage cryptographic keys (AWS: AWS KMS)
SC.L2-3.13.11: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography to protect CUI (AWS: KMS (FIPS endpoints) / ACM)
SC.L2-3.13.15: Protect authenticity of communications sessions (AWS: TLS / mutual TLS)
SC.L2-3.13.16: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest (AWS: KMS / S3 / EBS encryption)

components.title: Amazon VPC
components.description: Amazon VPC as used in this CMMC L2 environment.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.14: Route remote access via managed access control points (AWS: VPC / Transit Gateway / SSM)
AC.L2-3.1.20: Verify and control connections to external systems (AWS: SCPs / S3 policies / VPC endpoints)
CM.L2-3.4.6: Employ least functionality (essential capabilities only) (AWS: Security Groups / SSM)
CM.L2-3.4.7: Restrict disable or prevent nonessential programs ports protocols services (AWS: Security Groups / Config)
SC.L2-3.13.1: Monitor control and protect communications at system boundaries (AWS: VPC / Security Groups / WAF)
SC.L2-3.13.5: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible components (AWS: VPC public/private subnets)
SC.L2-3.13.6: Deny network traffic by default and allow by exception (AWS: Security Groups / NACLs)
SC.L2-3.13.9: Terminate network connections at end of session or after inactivity (AWS: Load balancer / idle timeout)
